    For a first visit City Centre (Ward 11)
    Higher caution advisedday Higher caution advisednight
    7 of the city's main sights are close enough to walk between. Still a practical base for a first visit, for its location and what is within walking distance of it. The safety evidence points the other way, and the rating is a reason to take extra care — particularly after dark — not by itself a reason to avoid the area. Find a place in City Centre (Ward 11) →
